item.title: #003: Property Price Prediction Using XGBoost & Model Optimization (Polish Cities)!
item.description:
Business Objective: Developed a regression model to predict Apartment Price in order to support setting the optimal listing price or determining the appropriate insurance value.

Data & Feature Engineering:

Processed 122 873 records with 9 features. Key features: squareMeters, rooms, buildYear, collegeDistance, centreDistance, floorCount, poiCount, hasElevator, city.

Implemented:

  • rigorous EDA (distribution analysis, target leakage checks, feature–target relationships),
  • outlier treatment using box plots,
  • removed outliers using the IQR method to prevent extreme values from distorting model performance.,
  • feature transformations: new variables (‘age_of_building’) are created to enhance model performance, and categorical features are encoded,
  • multicollinearity diagnostics (correlation thresholds).

Modeling Strategy:

Established a comparative pipeline evaluating Linear Regression vs. XGBoost. Used GridSearchCV with cross-validation (k = 5) to systematically optimize key hyperparameters. Assessment focused on generalization performance, stability across folds, and error variance.

item.title: #002: Are All Horoscopes Positive? (NLP + Sentiment + Similarity Analysis)!
item.description:
Project Overview

This project investigates whether daily horoscopes are genuinely positive, whether different zodiac signs receive varying emotional tones, and how often horoscope texts are reused. I collected 3 years of daily horoscopes across all 12 zodiac signs and applied modern NLP techniques to analyze sentiment, repetition, and thematic structure.

Core techniques:

  • Web scraping (3-year dataset, 12 signs)
  • Sentiment analysis (VADER + Hugging Face transformer)
  • Semantic similarity (MiniLM embeddings + cosine similarity)
  • Statistical testing (chi-square, post-hoc, bootstrapping)
  • NLP EDA (word clouds, timelines, bar plots)
